details.description: Kores Colour Pencils are richly pigmented wooden pencils designed for smooth shading and consistent colour application. They offer strong pigmentation and a comfortable grip, making them ideal for school art, colouring books, and creative projects. Easy to sharpen and durable, these pencils deliver neat, vibrant results for everyday drawing and artistic expression.
details.usageInstructions: Use on paper for drawing and colouring; replace the cap after use.

details.description: Kores Oil Pastels are bright coloured oil pastels. These colours have a smooth laydown that gives even colouring coverage. Oil pastels are perfect for beginners to learn new skills. You can use a scraper tool for enhancing your drawing with scratch and an embossed effect. These colours give good coverage, are deep and rich colour and have an incredibly soft and intensive colour stroke. It has wide coverage and convenient grip.
details.usageInstructions:
Perfect for beginners to learn new skills. 
Use it for drawing or colouring.

details.description: Jumbo Wax Crayons – 13 Shades feature easy-grip, thick crayons in bright and vibrant colours. Designed for little artists, they ensure a comfortable hold and smooth application for bold, even colouring. Ideal for school activities and creative projects, these crayons encourage creativity while providing durability, excellent coverage and a mess-free colouring experience for young learners.
details.usageInstructions: Use on paper for drawing and colouring; replace the cap after use.

details.description: Kores Sketch Pens, Regular are excellent for introducing children to the world of liquid colours in pen form. You can choose sketch pens with different tips like brush tip, round shape nib, fibre tip, soft or felt tip according to your requirements. It’s all about having fun and letting your child explore the world through its own imagination – there’s no limit.

Kores Dual Tip Brush & Sketch Pens offer versatile creativity with dual tips, featuring a flexible brush tip for bold strokes and a fine tip for detailed work. Ideal for artists, students, and hobbyists, these pens ensure smooth ink flow and vibrant colours. Perfect for sketching, lettering, colouring, and creative projects, they deliver precision, control, and professional-quality results every time.
details.usageInstructions: Use on paper for drawing and colouring; replace the cap after use.

details.description: Kores Poster Colours are vibrant, water-based paints designed for artists, students and creative projects. They offer smooth application, rich pigmentation and excellent coverage on paper and card. Easy to blend and quick to dry, these colours are ideal for posters, artwork and school assignments, delivering bright, consistent and long-lasting results with a clean, matte finish.
details.usageInstructions: Wet the colour or squeeze it out, mix with water as needed and apply with a brush on paper.

details.description: Kores Mat Geo Geometry Box is a tin geometry box. It is durable and has an attractive design. The ruler protractor and set square are made of high transparency plastic and the divider and compass are made with not-rusting durable material. It comes with a precise marking for perfect and accurate reading. For safety and long-lasting life of divider and compass cover the sharp edge points with provided cap. The Instrument Box contains a compass, a divider, 45 degrees set square, 60 degrees set square, pencil, scale, protractor, eraser, and a sharpener. A perfect box to be used in School.
details.usageInstructions:
It is used for technical drawing to make circles or arcs.
It can also be used as a tool to step out distances on maps.
details.dangerWarnings: Contains sharp parts. Keep away from young children and use with care.

details.description: Kores Max Mathematical Drawing Instruments / Geometry Box is a complete set designed for precise mathematical drawing and calculations. It includes essential tools such as a compass, divider, ruler, and protractor, ensuring accuracy and ease of use. Ideal for students, it is perfect for geometry work, technical drawing, and school examinations, offering durability and reliable performance.
details.usageInstructions: Use the instruments to measure, draw straight lines, circles and angles.
details.dangerWarnings: Contains sharp parts. Keep away from young children and use with care.
